managedCronJobs.purpose: Daily cloud-backup safety check (backup habit Anthony approved Nov 9, 2026: back up on every change, a batched full check ~30 seconds after changes finish, a sync when the app closes, and one daily check): records the check and runs a full sync to the Supabase collection backup whenever a recorded collection change is newer than the last completed full sync or the last full sync is over a day old, so a failed per-change push heals within a day. Runs after the morning re-pricing and audits.
Daily re-pricing of the collection's market values; appends one point per day to the value-over-time history. Paid amounts stay as recorded.

Daily audit of the card catalog against the complete Lorcana card universe (LorcanaJSON, Lorcast, DL Promos): inserts newly released or newly sourced printings so every card can be scanned, searched, and added. Existing cards, ownership, and prices are never touched.

Nightly price audit (requested by Anthony Nov 6, 2026 after the Promo Set 3 mispricing): scans every card's tracked price history for an implausible latest one-day jump (≥4x or ≤1/4 and ≥$5), restores the last good value, deletes the bad history point, recomputes a same-day portfolio snapshot the bad point fed, and logs the run plus every repair to the price audit log shown in Settings. Runs after the 06:30 re-pricing so that day's writes are audited the same morning.

Daily Topps Alternate Universe section-art sourcing: finds official publisher product artwork for AU set tiles (Disney Topps, Star Wars Topps, Garbage Pail Kids, WWE Topps) still on the placeholder and replaces art rows whose stored source the app can no longer fetch, saving each verified image via importSectionArt. Sets with no official product image anywhere keep the clean placeholder.

Daily collector-source card-art hunt (Anthony, Nov 6, 2026: Topps checklists are text-only, so he directed the hunt to other sites, naming Collectr): finds front photos of the exact card for Topps-family cards still missing artwork. Pull source is COMC's photographed card fronts (other marketplaces with standardized front photos when COMC lacks a card); the Trading Card Database is reference-only (confirms a front exists — its terms bar image extraction); Collectr joins via its API only once Anthony's own key is approved and is not used until then. Disney Topps (Chrome Disney first), then Star Wars Topps, Garbage Pail Kids, WWE Topps, and the Topps/Bowman sports catalogs, saving each verified image via importCardArt. Cards no permitted source carries keep the clean placeholder; no URL is ever guessed, and prices/ownership are never touched.

Daily Funko market recording: appends today's sold-based value point to each researched Funko figure's value history (eBay sold data) and refreshes its catalog price, so Funko value history accumulates on the same cadence as card re-pricing.

Daily Topps sold-price lookup (Anthony, Nov 10, 2026 — built for his sister's Disney Topps collection): an agent task prices owned Topps-family cards (Disney Topps first) from the most recent eBay SOLD listing of the exact card (TCGplayer where the exact product exists, COMC listing third), saving each verified value via saveToppsSoldPrice so values show as 'last sold' with their sale date and history accrues. Starts nothing when no Topps cards are owned.

Nightly re-pricing of TCGplayer-linked Pokémon cards (owned first, then stalest): refreshes each card's TCGplayer market price for its own finish via the Pokémon TCG API, stamps source and date, and appends today's value-history point.

Nightly re-pricing of TCGplayer-linked Magic: The Gathering printings (owned first, then stalest): refreshes Scryfall's published USD price for the exact printing, stamps source and date, and appends today's value-history point.

Nightly re-pricing of TCGplayer-linked Star Wars Unlimited cards (owned first, then stalest): refreshes TCGplayer's own pricepoints for the linked product (Foil or Normal by the card's finish), stamps source and date, and appends today's value-history point.
